definitions.gloss: to complain; to express dissatisfaction; to grumble
definitions.explanation: To voice one's displeasure or discontent about a situation, treatment, or condition.

examples.japanese: {不平|ふへい}を{言|い}わず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{不平|ふへい}を{言|い}う⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many employees who complain that their salary is low.

examples.japanese: {不平|ふへい}を{言|い}う⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ほしい。
examples.english: Nothing will change just by complaining, so I'd like you to make specific suggestions.

notes:
A combination of ⟦{不平|ふへい}→不平：03602_fuhei⟧ (dissatisfaction, discontent) and ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say). More formal and direct than ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}う→愚痴を言う：25447_guchiwoiu⟧. While ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧ implies venting about things that cannot be changed, ⟦{不平|ふへい}→不平：03602_fuhei⟧ implies genuine grievances directed at something specific.

Often paired with ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧ in the compound ⟦{不平|ふへい}{不満|ふまん}→不平不満：16284_fuheifuman⟧ (complaints and dissatisfaction).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不平|ふへい}を{言|い}う: to complain
- ⟦{不平|ふへい}→不平：03602_fuhei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧: to let slip a complaint
- ⟦{不平|ふへい}{不満|ふまん}→不平不満：16284_fuheifuman⟧: complaints and dissatisfaction
- ⟦{不平|ふへい}{不満|ふまん}→不平不満：16284_fuheifuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧: to harbor complaints and dissatisfaction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}う→愚痴を言う：25447_guchiwoiu⟧: to grumble; to gripe — more about venting, often about unchangeable things
- ⟦{文句|もんく}を{言|い}う→文句を言う：21303_monkuwoiu⟧: to complain; to object — the most common and versatile complaint expression
- ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to make a complaint — more formal, often directed at a business or service
